subject: general
question: Which ministry governs the Sahakar Pragya initiative?
solution:
The correct answer is the __**Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers’ Welfare **__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Sahakar Pragya Initiative** is an important program introduced by India's Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare.
 
• It aims to **promote and strengthen the cooperative movement in the country.**
 
• The initiative focuses on creating awareness about the **cooperative sector and its potential for socio-economic development.**
 
• It** includes training programs, workshops, seminars**, and capacity-building initiatives to empower cooperative societies and their members. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sahakar Pragya Initiative: Objectives**
 
• To t**rain the cooperative societies in rural areas with 45 new training module**s with the support of
 
 
• NCDC Schemes
 
• 1000 Farmers Producer Organizations
 
• Dairy Infrastructure Development Scheme
 
• Fisheries Infrastructure Development Scheme
 
• Agriculture Infrastructure Funding Scheme
 
• Pradhan Mantri Matasya Sampada Yojana
 
• Pradhan Mantri Formalization of Micro food Processing Enterprise (PMFME) Program
 
 
 
• To educate the farmers about **agricultural management using Primary Cooperatives.**
 
• To **strengthen the cooperative sector** and make it capable of shielding the farmers from unfair trade practices and unscrupulous traders.
 
• To enhance the training capacity of NCDC by** establishing 18 Regional Training Centers.**
 
• To educate and make the farmer** community self-aware and self-sufficient **to make the rural economy sustainable and aatmanirbhar.
